chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who commits adultery multiple times in a single day.

He said: "If he commits adultery with one woman, so many times, then only one hadd applies to him. But if he commits adultery with different women in one day or in one hour, then upon him there is a hadd for every woman with whom he committed immorality."

key_terms.يَزْنِي: commits zina, meaning unlawful sexual intercourse

ai.seo_question: How is the hadd counted if a man commits zina multiple times in one day?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on repeated zina within a short period. If the act is repeated with the same woman, one hadd applies; if it is committed with different women, a separate hadd applies for each woman. It is significant as a concise fiqh text on how legal punishment is counted in repeated sexual offenses.
